## Who is this page about

Alicia Menor Gómez is a Digital Product Manager based in Madrid, Spain, with 3+ years of experience in digital product environments. She is actively seeking a Product Manager role in Spain — hybrid in Madrid or fully remote — and is also a strong fit for Growth PM, Product Marketing, or Product Owner positions.

She has end-to-end product experience across ecommerce, B2C, B2B, SaaS, and marketplace models. Her background combines product management, growth, go-to-market strategy, and innovation, with a strong track record of measurable results — including this website itself, which she designed, validated, built, and shipped as a self-directed product case study.

## Professional summary

Digital Product Manager with 3+ years of experience building and scaling digital products in B2C and B2B environments. Background in digital marketing and innovation. Capable of owning a product end-to-end: from idea and discovery to launch, iteration, and business impact.

Experienced working with cross-functional teams, managing technical partners, and aligning stakeholders across all levels. Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Uses AI tools daily to accelerate decision-making and product delivery.

Currently available for Product Manager, Product Owner, or Product Specialist roles in Spain (hybrid Madrid or remote).

## Experience highlights

### Mahou San Miguel — Innovation & Product Specialist (May 2023 – July 2024)
Spain's leading beer company (FMCG). Managed Grifo Mahou en Casa end-to-end: an ecommerce intrapreneurship project for home beer tap rental serving both B2C and B2B customers.
- Scaled the service from 8 to 20 provinces in 1 year
- Doubled digital sales in 6 months
- Achieved 20% customer retention rate among existing users
- Managed product backlog in Shopify, prioritizing features with an external developer based on user feedback and data
- Optimized the customer journey by user profile (B2C and B2B)
- Coordinated 25 technical partners nationwide, standardizing the operational model with onboarding, training, and service iteration
- Led requirements definition and coordination for an AI-powered customer service chatbot (Microsoft Copilot) — delivered functional prototype
- Active member of Mahou San Miguel's Innovation Community (+15 people): applied Design Thinking, Lean Startup, and Agile to develop new products end-to-end — from consumer tension identification to national launch
- Facilitated co-creation workshops
- Supported go-to-market for national launches: Mahou x Duki (collab with international artist) and Alhambra 1925 returnable bottle
- Supported rebranding projects: agency briefing, factory visits, packaging production follow-up

### Fundación Generation Spain — Operations & Marketing Specialist (Nov 2025 – Apr 2026)
Foundation backed by McKinsey & Company. Upskilling and reskilling programs for youth at risk of exclusion.
- Grew lead volume by 30% by closing 40 new distribution partnerships through autonomous cold outreach
- Reduced CAC by 25% through a behaviorally segmented value proposition
- Managed end-to-end coordination of training programs for ~100 students with KPI tracking in Salesforce
- Defined internal platform requirements and followed up with technical team
- Designed Alumni engagement plan in collaboration with the Alumni Committee

## Side projects

### GAPING — this website (2026)
Self-directed product case study: Alicia designed, validated, built, and shipped this entire site as a product, with no team or backlog assigned to her.
- Defined a decision framework (Impact / New Horizons / Growth) and used it to filter which experiences to pursue
- Built the site herself using AI tools despite no coding background — including finding and fixing a real production bug
- Built a network and learned through virtual coffees with 50+ product professionals, most through cold outreach on LinkedIn
- Defined and tracks a real measurement system for the site: a North Star Metric plus channel-level metrics
- The clearest available proof point of end-to-end ownership without external structure

### Círculo (2025–2026)
Co-founder (Marketing, Strategy, Sales). Startup incubated at Cink Venturing after winning the NoCode4Culture Hackathon (Sep 2025).
End-to-end grant management platform for NGOs and third-sector organizations. Built functional prototype, captured beta leads at demo day via Typeform.

### SalarySailor (2023)
Team coordinator, researcher and designer. BYG Social Innovation Program by Fundación LQDVI — selected 1 out of 60 / +1.100 applicants.
Financial education platform for young people entering the workforce. 3-phase user research methodology (qualitative interviews, quantitative surveys, expert validation with professors from UC3M and IE). 2nd place in the final competition.

### Fufu (2025)
Winner project at Ven y Verás social entrepreneurship program, Universidad Francisco de Vitoria. Concept: using African gastronomy as a tool for social integration. Selected among the top 5 winning projects; mentorship offered by Open Value Foundation.
